contract: GET /public/share/:slug/track/:index. Serve a valid share-session track with audio MIME/range support; wrong track/cookie/share or expired capability denies without exposing arbitrary files.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.

invariants.contract: GET /public/share/:slug/track/:index requires the share_session_id cookie (404 without), an open share and a session whose mediaItemShareId is that share, and parseInt matching of index (404 for unknown, non-numeric or out-of-range indices) before any file is read. Success serves the item's audio file with Accept-Ranges: bytes and the extension's audio MIME (audio/mp4 for .m4b, audio/mpeg for .mp3), the full bytes or a 206 byte range with Content-Range; a range at or past EOF answers 416 with Content-Range bytes */<size> and no media bytes. Deleted or expired shares answer 404. With USE_X_ACCEL the route answers 204 with X-Accel-Redirect naming the encoded absolute audio path and no body.
